paragraphs: TalkingPoints sells a PreK-12 family engagement platform to school districts and schools. It is organized as a nonprofit education technology organization. The platform defaults to text messaging, so families do not need an app or a login to take part. Translation is offered in 150+ languages.

Products named on the site include daily messaging tools, emergency alerts and district communications, attendance tools, and professional learning for educators. The attendance tools are described as helping schools understand why students miss class, and the professional learning is aimed at building educator capacity for family partnerships.

Fairfax County Public Schools is named as a district whose schools all use the platform as a communication tool. Green Bay Area Public Schools adopted the platform when schools closed, and it is now described as a districtwide connector for all families.

quote.text: TalkingPoints partners with districts across the country
